app.faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
app.faq.subtitle: Straight answers on the demo, trial, and billing.
app.faq.q1: Do I need a card for the demo or the 7-day trial?
app.faq.a1: You can explore the interactive demo without a card. The 7-day trial starts when you formally activate your salon with a plan on Stripe — that’s when a payment method is required.
app.faq.q2: What if I have more employees than my plan allows?
app.faq.a2: Pro and Premium plans have no limit. If you're on Basic and grow, you can upgrade anytime from your billing dashboard.
app.faq.a3: Yes. You can cancel your subscription at any time. You'll keep access until the end of the period you already paid for.
app.faq.q4: Does it work in Nicaragua and the United States?
app.faq.a4: Yes. Shearly is available in Nicaragua and the United States, with pricing adapted to each region.
app.faq.a5: Galil Innovations LLC is the company behind Shearly, with experience building solutions for the beauty and aesthetics industry.
